verdict: Paid Instagram is profitable this period, but pixel tracking gaps and thin engagement signals are masking the real picture.
diagnosis: Instagram spend of $2,166 drove 562 purchases worth $11,972 — strong sales, but only 63 tracked back to the pixel.

signals.headline: 562 purchases on $2,166 spend
signals.detail: Reported sales value hit $11,972 this period. Strong efficiency for a subscription box campaign at this spend level.

signals.headline: Only 63 pixel-tracked purchases
signals.detail: Platform reports 562 purchases but pixel confirms 63. Attribution gap makes optimization decisions risky this period.

signals.headline: 237 add-to-carts, 94 checkouts started
signals.detail: Roughly 40% of cart adds begin checkout. Drop-off between cart and checkout is where money leaks this period.

signals.headline: 272 reviews, 5-star latest rating
signals.detail: Google profile shows healthy review velocity with 2 new reviews this period. Local trust signal is working.

signals.headline: 6,654 followers, 357 profile visits
signals.detail: Only 106 new followers this period against 8.9M impressions. Awareness is high but profile pull-through is weak.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Global ecommerce conversion averages 1.7% to 2.5% in 2026. Shopify median is 1.4%, top stores exceed 3.2%. Cold paid social traffic typically converts lower than branded search.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Subscription acquisition costs climbing this year
seasonal.body: 88% of subscription brands report higher acquisition costs in 2025. Meal-kit category churn runs 12 to 18% monthly, meaning brands must constantly replace subscribers before growing.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: Global meat subscription market projected to grow from $1.7B in 2024 to $7.1B by 2034. ButcherBox, Good Ranchers, and Crowd Cow dominate. Niche positioning like halal-certified boxes is a real edge.

recommendations.title: Fix the Meta pixel before scaling spend
recommendations.detail: Platform shows 562 purchases, pixel shows 63. Consider a full pixel and Conversions API audit this week so optimization runs on real data.

recommendations.title: Test a checkout drop-off recovery flow
recommendations.detail: 237 add-to-carts produced 94 checkouts. Worth exploring cart abandonment email and SMS sequences to recover the 143 shoppers who stalled.

recommendations.title: Double down on the Muslim Box angle
recommendations.detail: Halal-certified subscription is a defensible niche versus ButcherBox and Good Ranchers. Consider testing more creative variants under this awareness angle.
